candidates.description: This feature vector represents automated systems, artificial agents, and digital security threats.
This vector represents common Spanish nouns in both singular and plural forms, frequently used in technical, programming, or formal contexts.
This vector represents common noun-forming suffixes and related abstract nouns across Romance languages.
This vector is related to common action verbs in Spanish.
This feature vector represents Spanish-language roots, prefixes, and common vocabulary related to civic, economic, and institutional domains.
This vector is related to Spanish past participles and verb inflection suffixes denoting completed actions or states.
This feature vector represents the concept of variety, difference, or multiplicity across multiple languages.
These tokens represent concepts of importance, necessity, specificity, and difficulty, primarily in Spanish.
This vector represents Spanish noun-forming suffixes related to the "-tion" or "-sion" ending.
This feature vector represents the concept of utilization, usage, and the Spanish and English verbs for using or applying something.
